environment: uv-managed .venv with gnn and dev dependencies
replay_inputs: Previously saved actual river geometry, paths and fixed observational population from the preceding river-form studies
Saved primary activity downloads or the one declared historical-cache fallback
Saved additional public-station activity and mapping tables
Saved station discovery and continuous-series catalogue responses
collection_note: These scripts recover and prepare provider records. A result replay uses the saved responses and additional-station products; it does not assume unchanged live providers or independently rediscover the population.
